import { type PropertyValues } from 'lit';
import { KrdsElement } from '../base.js';
import { type DateValue, type CalendarTranslations } from './model.js';
export declare class Calendar extends KrdsElement {
    static properties: {
        mode: {
            type: StringConstructor;
        };
        value: {
            attribute: boolean;
        };
        defaultValue: {
            attribute: boolean;
        };
        min: {
            type: StringConstructor;
        };
        max: {
            type: StringConstructor;
        };
        disabled: {
            type: BooleanConstructor;
        };
        required: {
            type: BooleanConstructor;
        };
        referenceDate: {
            attribute: string;
        };
        today: {
            type: StringConstructor;
        };
        translations: {
            attribute: boolean;
        };
        tentative: {
            state: boolean;
        };
        view: {
            state: boolean;
        };
    };
    mode: 'single' | 'range';
    value: DateValue | undefined;
    defaultValue: DateValue | undefined;
    min: string | undefined;
    max: string | undefined;
    disabled: boolean;
    required: boolean;
    referenceDate: string;
    today: string | undefined;
    translations: Partial<CalendarTranslations>;
    private tentative;
    private view;
    private state;
    private previous;
    private initialMode?;
    constructor();
    get committedValue(): DateValue;
    willUpdate(_changed: PropertyValues): void;
    private unavailable;
    private selected;
    private select;
    private canConfirm;
    private confirm;
    private navigate;
    private canNavigate;
    focusDate(date: string): Promise<void>;
    private key;
    updated(): void;
    render(): import("lit").TemplateResult<1>;
}
